point=default_point('on');captured={}
class Captured(BaseException):pass
def capture(state,segments,cfg,steps,**kwargs):
 captured.update(state=state.copy(),segments=list(segments),cfg=cfg)
 raise Captured
original=suite.protocol_simulate;suite.protocol_simulate=capture
options=dict(calfit=True,speed_tier='literature',wall_candidate=point,wall_profile='legacy_v1',execution_cap_m_s=2.,shoulder_width_m=.46,pedestrian_contact_rule='projection_v1',pedestrian_wall_rule='bounded_edge_v1')

 try:suite.run_task(('V4',1001,'5.0',.28,'radius',options))

if not np.array_equal(captured['state'][:,:2],positions[0]):raise ValueError('snapshot starts differ from current approved input')
desired=np.asarray(json.loads(path.with_suffix('.json').read_text())['desired_speeds_m_s'])

result={'source_sha':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root/'repo',text=True).strip(),'baseline_sha':'ead48d9c5247c8d14f3b65d3d46774a37628cb2f','baseline_simulator_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'old_simulator_ead.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'seed':1001,'frame':frame,'dt_s':.1,'radius_m':.28,'warmup_steps':1,'timed_steps':20,'scope':'same real V4 crowded snapshot; exact captured CALFIT goals/config/desired speeds; explicit 2m/s integration cap','driver_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'installed_contact_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.modules['pysocialforce.contact'].__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'cases':[]}
for n in [60,150,350]:
 for mode in ['off','on']:

  xy=positions[frame,:n];vel=(positions[frame,:n]-positions[frame-1,:n])/.1

   del cfg.pedestrian_contact_rule

  sim=sim_class(state,obstacles=walls,config=cfg);sim.peds.assign_desired_speeds(desired[:n])

  def capped(force,*args,**kwargs):
   desired=sim.peds.max_speeds.copy();sim.peds.max_speeds=np.full(n,2.);sim.peds.contact_step_speed_caps=sim.peds.max_speeds.copy()
   try:return integrate(force,*args,**kwargs)
   finally:sim.peds.max_speeds=desired
  sim.peds.step=capped
  def update():sim.peds.state[sim.peds.pos()[:,0]>1.2,4]=21.
  update();sim.step();times=[];passes=[]

   update();start=time.perf_counter();sim.step();times.append(1000*(time.perf_counter()-start));passes.append(getattr(sim,'contact_projection_passes',0))

else:
 matrix=ROOT/'configs/policy_search/nominal_sanity_matrix.yaml'
 scenarios=[dict(sc) for sc in load_scenarios(matrix,base_dir=matrix.parent) if sc['name'] in PROBES]
 if sorted(sc['name'] for sc in scenarios)!=sorted(PROBES):raise ValueError('probe roster mismatch')

 payload=yaml.safe_load((ROOT/empty.SUITES['main']).read_text())

 payload['planners']=[pl for pl in payload['planners'] if pl['key']==arm]
 for slot in ('release_tag','doi'):payload[slot]='pedcontact-dev-unpublished'
 cfgpath=out/'campaign.yaml'

cfg=load_campaign_config(cfgpath);resolved=_load_campaign_scenarios(cfg)

if seen!=[seed]:raise ValueError('unexpected resolved seeds')

  if row['metrics'].get('obstacle_collision_count'):

"""Lossless trajectory custody codec; verifies original ZIP bytes before removal."""
import argparse, hashlib, io, json, pickle, struct, zlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

def pack(raw):
 import zipfile
 parts=[];cursor=0;decoded={}
 with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as zipf:
  for info in sorted(zipf.infolist(),key=lambda x:x.header_offset):
   off=info.header_offset;name,extra=struct.unpack_from('<HH',raw,off+26);start=off+30+name+extra;end=start+info.compress_size
   stream=raw[start:end];plain=zipf.read(info.filename)
   # The original compressed stream is reconstructible only under this checked codec.
   enc=zlib.compressobj(6,zlib.DEFLATED,-15)
   if enc.compress(plain)+enc.flush()!=stream:raise ValueError('non-reconstructible deflate stream')
   f=io.BytesIO(plain);version=np.lib.format.read_magic(f)
   shape,order,dtype=(np.lib.format.read_array_header_1_0(f) if version == (1,0) else np.lib.format.read_array_header_2_0(f))
   offset=f.tell();mode='literal';data=plain
   if dtype.kind in 'fiu' and not order and len(shape)>=1:
    a=np.frombuffer(plain[offset:],dtype=np.dtype('u'+str(dtype.itemsize))).copy().reshape(shape)
    if len(a)>1:a[1:]=a[1:]^a[:-1]
    byte=a.reshape(-1).view(np.uint8).reshape(-1,dtype.itemsize).T.copy().tobytes()
    data=plain[:offset]+byte;mode='xor_shuffle'
   encoded=zlib.compress(data,6)
   array=np.load(io.BytesIO(plain),allow_pickle=False)
   if info.filename=='speeds.npy' and 'positions.npy' in decoded and array.dtype.kind=='f':
    pos=decoded['positions.npy']
    if pos.shape[0]==array.shape[0]+1 and pos.shape[1]==array.shape[1]:
     guess=np.sqrt(np.sum((np.diff(pos,axis=0)/.1)**2,axis=-1)).astype(array.dtype)
     unsigned=np.dtype('u'+str(array.dtype.itemsize))
     residual=array.view(unsigned)^guess.view(unsigned)
     shuffled=residual.reshape(-1).view(np.uint8).reshape(-1,array.dtype.itemsize).T.copy().tobytes()
     candidate=zlib.compress(plain[:offset]+shuffled,6)
     if len(candidate)<len(encoded):encoded=candidate;mode='motion_residual_shuffle'
   decoded[info.filename]=array
   parts.append((raw[cursor:start],encoded,mode,offset,shape,dtype.str,info.compress_size,info.filename));cursor=end
 return pickle.dumps((parts,raw[cursor:]),protocol=5)

def unpack(blob):
 parts,tail=pickle.loads(blob);out=bytearray();decoded={}
 for part in parts:
  prefix,encoded,mode,offset,shape,dtype,compressed_size=part[:7]
  if len(part)==8:name=part[7]
  else:
   header=prefix.rfind(b'PK\x03\x04');length=struct.unpack_from('<H',prefix,header+26)[0]
   name=prefix[header+30:header+30+length].decode()
  data=zlib.decompress(encoded)
  if mode in {'xor_shuffle','motion_residual_shuffle'}:
   size=np.dtype(dtype).itemsize;byte=np.frombuffer(data[offset:],np.uint8).reshape(size,-1).T.copy()
   a=byte.reshape(-1).view(np.dtype('u'+str(size))).reshape(shape)
   if mode=='xor_shuffle' and len(a)>1:a=np.bitwise_xor.accumulate(a,axis=0)
   elif mode=='motion_residual_shuffle':
    guess=np.sqrt(np.sum((np.diff(decoded['positions.npy'],axis=0)/.1)**2,axis=-1)).astype(dtype)
    a=a^guess.view(np.dtype('u'+str(size)))
   data=data[:offset]+a.tobytes()
  decoded[name]=np.load(io.BytesIO(data),allow_pickle=False)
  enc=zlib.compressobj(6,zlib.DEFLATED,-15);stream=enc.compress(data)+enc.flush()
  if len(stream)!=compressed_size:raise ValueError('codec changed original compressed size')
  out.extend(prefix);out.extend(stream)
 out.extend(tail);return bytes(out)

if __name__=='__main__':
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('root',type=Path);p.add_argument('--delete',action='store_true');p.add_argument('--limit',type=int);a=p.parse_args();index=[]
 for path in list(sorted(a.root.rglob('*.npz')))[:a.limit]:
  raw=path.read_bytes()
  try:archive=pack(raw)
  except (ValueError,TypeError) as e:print(path,e,flush=True);continue
  assert unpack(archive)==raw
  target=path.with_suffix('.npz.pcx');target.write_bytes(archive)
  assert hashlib.sha256(unpack(target.read_bytes())).digest()==hashlib.sha256(raw).digest()
  index.append(dict(path=str(path.relative_to(a.root)),archive=str(target.relative_to(a.root)),original_bytes=len(raw),archive_bytes=len(archive),original_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),archive_sha256=hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest()))
  if a.delete:path.unlink()
  if len(index)%100==0:print('ARCHIVED',len(index),sum(x['original_bytes'] for x in index),sum(x['archive_bytes'] for x in index),flush=True)
 (a.root/'LOSSLESS_ARCHIVE_INDEX.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(codec='temporal_or_motion_uint_xor_byte_shuffle_zlib6_reconstructed_deflate_v2',zlib_version=zlib.ZLIB_RUNTIME_VERSION,decoder_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),members=index),indent=2))
 print('TOTAL',len(index),sum(x['original_bytes'] for x in index),sum(x['archive_bytes'] for x in index),flush=True)

"""Run explicit audited test paths, preserving collection and validation receipts."""
import argparse,json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'repo'; OUT=Path(__file__).parent/'evidence'/'round3'/'tests'
mode=sys.argv[1]
serial='--serial' in sys.argv
label=mode+('_serial' if serial else '')
files=json.loads((OUT/(mode+'_files.json')).read_text())
env=dict(os.environ,OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',
 XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(ROOT.parent/'cache'),MPLCONFIGDIR=str(ROOT.parent/'cache'/'mpl'),
 NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=str(ROOT.parent/'cache'/'numba'),TMPDIR=str(ROOT.parent/'tmp'),
 HF_HOME=str(ROOT.parent/'cache'/'hf'),TORCH_HOME=str(ROOT.parent/'cache'/'torch'),
 PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT.parent),PATH=str(ROOT/'.venv/bin')+os.pathsep+os.environ['PATH'],PEDCONTACT_GUARD_RECEIPT=str(OUT/'seed_refusals.jsonl'))
(ROOT.parent/'tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
command=[str(ROOT/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-p','lane_seed_guard_round2',*files]
if serial:command+=['-p','no:xdist']
collect=command+['--collect-only','-q']
with (OUT/(label+'_collection.log')).open('w') as log:
 rc=subprocess.run(collect,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
if rc:raise SystemExit(rc)
nodes=[line.split('::')[0] for line in (OUT/(label+'_collection.log')).read_text().splitlines() if '::' in line and not line.startswith(' ')]
excluded={r['path'] for r in json.loads((OUT/'excluded_files.json').read_text())}
if any(node in excluded for node in nodes):raise RuntimeError('excluded file collected')
workers=4 if float(Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().split()[0])>12 else 8
if mode=='full':command+=['--cov=robot_sf','--cov-branch','--cov-report=json:'+str(OUT/'full_coverage.json'),'--cov-report=term:skip-covered']
run=command+([] if serial else ['-n',str(workers)])+['-q',f'--junitxml={OUT}/{label}_junit.xml','--basetemp='+str(ROOT.parent/'tmp'/('pytest_round3_'+label))]
(OUT/(label+'_command.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'command':run,'files':len(files),'workers':workers,'slow_tests_included':True},indent=2))
with (OUT/(label+'_run.log')).open('w') as log:
 rc=subprocess.run(run,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
print(mode,'exit',rc,'files',len(files),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(rc)

"""Compare every tracked config/schema/golden file against the CALFIT base bytes."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).parent/'repo';BASE='e6d52b556e2b0f82ccb0a6efd2c7ac17fffa6e36'
entries=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','-z',BASE],cwd=ROOT).split(b'\0')
selected=[]
for raw in entries:
 if not raw:continue
 meta,path=raw.split(b'\t',1);p=path.decode()
 if p.startswith('configs/') or any(token in p.lower() for token in ('schema','golden')):
  mode,typ,oid=meta.split()
  if typ==b'blob':selected.append((p,oid.decode()))
proc=subprocess.Popen(['git','cat-file','--batch'],cwd=ROOT,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
rows=[]
for path,oid in selected:
 proc.stdin.write((oid+'\n').encode());proc.stdin.flush()
 header=proc.stdout.readline().split();size=int(header[2]);before=proc.stdout.read(size);proc.stdout.read(1)
 current=ROOT/path
 after=current.read_bytes() if current.is_file() else None
 rows.append({'path':path,'base_sha256':hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),'current_sha256':hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest() if after is not None else None,'identical':before==after})
proc.stdin.close();proc.wait()
out=ROOT.parent/'evidence/round3/protected_byte_comparison.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps({'base_sha':BASE,'head_sha':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),'count':len(rows),'all_identical':all(r['identical'] for r in rows),'approved_nonrelease_exception':'configs/benchmarks/pedestrian_validation_0_0_9.json','released_files_identical':all(r['identical'] for r in rows if r['path']!='configs/benchmarks/pedestrian_validation_0_0_9.json'),'historical_copy_matches_base':any(r['path']=='configs/benchmarks/pedestrian_validation_0_0_9.json' and r['base_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'configs/benchmarks/pedestrian_validation_0_0_9_history_v1.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for r in rows),'files':rows},indent=2))
print(len(rows),'files; all identical:',all(r['identical'] for r in rows))
if [r['path'] for r in rows if not r['identical']]!=['configs/benchmarks/pedestrian_validation_0_0_9.json']:raise SystemExit(1)
